title: A Base and an Arm in One Frame Tree: World, Base, Mount, Tool, and How an Error in the Base Becomes an Error at the Hand

artifact.note: the frames of a wheeled base with an arm on it: the base's pose in the world (x, y and heading on flat ground), the arm's mounting on the base (an offset, a height and a turn), the arm's own table and tool; the tool's pose in the world from the base pose and the joint angles; a point in the world put into the arm's own base frame (where the arm has to reach to); and the error at the hand that an error in the base's position or heading makes
